name: OPA1622
tagline: TI's 2015 dual headphone driver: 2.8 nV/√Hz, −119.2 dB THD+N at 100 mW/32 Ω, +145/−130 mA. Common in DAPs and phones.

lineage.note: Burr-Brown Audio / SoundPlus line; sole source. SBOS727B (May 2016) still current. PSpice models 1.3–1.5 (2019–2022) cite it.

part_numbers.note: VSON-10 DRC, 3000/reel, 'O1622', MSL 2, −40 to 125 °C. Used on OPA1622EVM (SBOU172, unconfirmed).
Orderable variant TI calls identical to IDRCR; not a die revision. Marked O1622.
250-unit reel, same die and marking. ACTIVE in 2015 addendum; RS lists discontinued.

key_specs.value: 2.8 nV/√Hz (4 at 100 Hz, 10 at 10 Hz); 2.1 µVpp
0.8 pA/√Hz at 1 kHz; 2.5 pA/√Hz at 10 Hz
±2 V to ±18 V (4–36 V); abs max 40 V; unequal rails OK
2.6 mA/ch typ, 3.3 max (4.2 max −40–125 °C); 5 µA off
+145 / −130 mA; swing 800 mV from rail (900 mV, 600 Ω)
±100 µV typ, ±500 µV max; 0.5 µV/°C drift
Bipolar, back-to-back clamp diodes (±0.5 V differential)

reputation.summary: A purpose-built headphone driver: very low THD+N into 16–32 Ω, 2.8 nV/√Hz and high current on 2.6 mA/ch suit battery gear. Reportedly used in FiiO (X7 AM3, X3 III, M9), Lotoo (PAW S1, Gold Touch, PAW6000) and HiBy (R3 Pro II, R6 Pro Max) players, vivo Xplay6, Smartisan M1L and Xiaomi MSM8996 phones, and the DIY AmpCasq headamp.
typical_uses: Headphone output in DAPs, USB dongles and phones
DAC diff-to-SE converter plus driver (TIDUAW1, unconfirmed)
Balanced 4.4/2.5 mm outputs, one device per leg
DIY integrated headamp (AmpCasq); post-DAC line buffer
Rolling on VSON-10-to-DIP-8 adapters (Audiophonics DIP8 unit)
caveats: VSON-10 only; exposed pad must go to V−, never ground. Sockets need an adapter.
Non-standard pinout with GND and EN pins; DIP adapters must synthesize them, possibly hurting PSRR.
EN must not float (thresholds 0.78/0.82 V vs GND); output is not high-Z in shutdown. Hold EN low during ramp-up.
About +145/−130 mA: TI's circuit gives 150 mW/32 Ω, 95 mW/16 Ω before clipping.
47.6 °C/W, shutdown at 175 °C; needs copper under the pad. Minimum ±2 V; input clamps ±0.5 V.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit reports found. Genuine parts are VSON-10 (DRC) marked 'O1622' with TI logo and lot code; '.B' orderables are identical. Adapter boards hide the chip and vary GND/EN wiring. 2021 shortages made it scarce; buy from authorized distributors.

revision_history.changes: Initial Product Preview release (per the rev A revision history).
Changed from product preview to production data. Still has the V+ pin-8 typo.
Added TI Design reference; fixed V+ pin number in Pin Functions; reformatted supply-voltage line. Documentation only; still current Nov 2026.

revision_chains.note: No copy of the original found; check Wayback for the sbos727 seed URLs. No rev C.
ZHCSEE5B confirmed on ti.com.cn (November 2015 – May 2016); earlier Chinese editions unseen.

open_questions: Find a copy of the November 2015 Product Preview (check Wayback for the sbos727 seed URLs).
Which revision does each mirror hold (alldatasheet 772558, alldatasheet.net 2222714, datasheet4u 1407316, datasheetcatalog, elecfans)?
Is OPA1622IDRCT still active at TI (RS lists it discontinued)? Which revision is the hqbuy Chinese copy?
Are there OPA1622-specific PCNs? Only generic TI fab PCNs surfaced. Is INA1620 built on the OPA1622 core?
Independent bare-chip measurements (ASR, Samuel Groner) and confirmation of the device-adoption lists are wanted.
